power_policy: wired external power, actual connection recorded
baseline_policy: Median of separate 600-second idle calibration after near-full-charge stable gate. Baseline limits are upper bounds only; a colder start is permitted. Absolute symmetric within-pair matching on skin, battery HAL, and nsp0 remains required. The reference is fixed for every pair.
overhead_policy: Same binary; full app telemetry plus 1 Hz HAL polling versus minimal telemetry without HAL polling; both retain request timing, counts, callbacks, thermal checks and result logging. Minimal is not zero overhead.

environment.source: User report in current conversation, 16 October 2026
environment.phone_use_policy: Requested stationary and no interaction during acquisition
environment.rest_display_context: Home screen selected before initial rest; other background services remain enabled.
environment.reconfirmation_source: User confirmation on 17 October 2026; actual room temperature remains unmeasured

stop_policy: One attempt per model under the unchanged recovery gate and deadline. Retain application errors, invalid or unlaunched calls, and missing or unsupported event evidence. No automatic restart.
analysis_policy: Report counts, errors, individual durations, starting sensors and trace coverage. Three requests within one capture are dependent observations; no inference from independent replicates, no pooling with primary or supplementary timing estimates.
timing_policy: Fixed call timer around SDK benchmark invocation, outside event/log writes; long duration starts at first measured invocation. Different app version and boundary from prior acquisitions.
unresolved: Zero-monitoring reference (minimal retains safety and timing)
amendment_rationale: User explicitly requested completing all feasible experiments after repeated USB failures; this grid is specified before any of its observations. Reuses the verified binary and package digests.
scheduling_policy: Three fixed paired units in their original planned member order; overhead FastVLM short, overhead Gemma long, main short. Actual order fixed in planned_units before first measurement.
purpose: Exploratory availability and application attribution of vendor kernel events during fixed NPU-requested calls; no operator-placement or absence-of-fallback claim
interpretation: Patterns are capability probes. A successful system trace or zero matching events does not establish vendor-event availability, zero NPU work, or complete offload. Retain setup diagnostics and report missing evidence explicitly.

power_counter_probe.interpretation: Battery counters under USB are net battery flow, not total device energy. Rail coverage/calibration unvalidated; report availability without energy-per-request or energy-efficiency claims.
